title: Is a 4-day work week better for productivity?
description: The debate assesses whether reducing the standard work week to four days improves productivity, wellbeing and business performance.

facts.fact: In the UK's six-month trial, 92% of participating companies continued or planned to continue the four-day week.
Participating companies reported a 65% reduction in sick days and a 57% fall in staff leaving.
Among 23 companies providing financial data, revenue rose by 1.4% on average during the trial.
Only 23 of the UK trial's participating organisations provided revenue data, limiting the financial evidence.
The trial was voluntary and involved a limited group of UK organisations rather than a representative national sample.
Company revenue broadly stayed the same during the trial, rather than showing a large productivity-driven increase.
